<translate>
'''Gete Robots''' are machines from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] that march on the Namekian villages of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. Their hits launch you into the air.
</translate>

<translate>
== Village raids ==

While you are near a Namekian village (Ajissa or Sacred), small waves of 1–2 robots can appear outside it every so often, up to 3 per village. They walk toward the village center and fight the [[Special:MyLanguage/Namekian Warrior|Namekian Warriors]] on the way, who are their main target.
</translate>

<translate>
== Metal Cooler patrols ==

Around the Big Gete Star, up to 2 patrols roam near players. Each patrol is a Metal Cooler scout leading 2–3 Gete Robots. The Big Gete Star's inner chamber is the lair of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Metal Cooler Core|Metal Cooler Core]] world boss.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior ==

Gete Robots fight on the '''Novice''' AI tier. The health and damage above are their base values.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops ==

Gete Robots drop nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==

The [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] quest [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] asks you to defeat 10 Gete Robots in the Ajissa Plains of Namek, before you face Metal Cooler and the Metal Cooler Core.
</translate>
